title: The weight restricted to O is H^n on spt V cap O with density ofReal(1_M theta)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and U a subset of R^(n+l). Let V = v(M, theta) be a rectifiable n-varifold in U, with M := V.carrier, theta := V.mult, mu := V.weight = (H^n restricted to M).withDensity (ofReal o theta), Sigma := V.support = U cap spt mu and H^n := muHE[n]. Let O be a measurable set with O contained in U. Then mu restricted to O equals (H^n restricted to (Sigma cap O)).withDensity f, where f(x) := ofReal(M.indicator theta x), i.e. f = 1_M * ofReal(theta).
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet O → O ⊆ U → V.weight.restrict O = ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ O)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (V.carrier.indicator V.mult x))
